# CREATE TABLE LIKE, COPY and CLONE
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language#create_table_like
#
# Each script creates the dataset unverified_create_table_copies and tables of its own. The dataset
# stays in the project after the scripts run.
#
# BigQuery has answered these, but the emulator still rejects LIKE AS SELECT with length
# parameters, which INSERT does not enforce either yet. The cases move to an
# end-to-end test once writes enforce them.

# Whether LIKE AS SELECT enforces the source's length parameters.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_create_table_copies;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_create_table_copies.length_src (s STRING(3));
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_create_table_copies.length_like LIKE unverified_create_table_copies.length_src AS SELECT 'abc' AS s;
SELECT s FROM unverified_create_table_copies.length_like
?> "abc"

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_create_table_copies;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_create_table_copies.length_src (s STRING(3));
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_create_table_copies.length_like LIKE unverified_create_table_copies.length_src AS SELECT 'abcd' AS s;
SELECT s FROM unverified_create_table_copies.length_like
?> error: Query error: Field s: STRING(3) has maximum length 3 but got a value with length 4 at [3:1]

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_create_table_copies;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_create_table_copies.bytes_src (b BYTES(3));
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_create_table_copies.bytes_like LIKE unverified_create_table_copies.bytes_src AS SELECT b'abcd' AS b;
SELECT b FROM unverified_create_table_copies.bytes_like
?> error: Query error: Field b: BYTES(3) has maximum length 3 but got a value with length 4 at [3:1]

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_create_table_copies;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_create_table_copies.nested_length_src (r STRUCT<s STRING(3)>);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_create_table_copies.nested_length_like LIKE unverified_create_table_copies.nested_length_src AS SELECT STRUCT('abcd' AS s) AS r;
SELECT r.s FROM unverified_create_table_copies.nested_length_like
?> error: Query error: Field r: STRING(3) has maximum length 3 but got a value with length 4 at [3:1]
